note: Re-pin 2026-11-17: Decode keeps the last token pending (executor.cc:1611-1632 at b7b856a0; the release 6da75396 1580-1601); tasks.cc:817-822 stop filter; engine_settings.h:277-280 use_external_sampler_ false; git grep at b7b856a0: no UseExternalSampler setter in runtime/, c/ or swift/ outside tests. js/packages left our tree in the prune (cited at base). tasks.cc:362-377 at the pin: our e62e6ff1 (2026-11-17, after the release) rolls back only the tokens after the stop token in a speculative round, so the stop token stays pending there too; the release still rolls back one more (6da75396 tasks.cc:363-373). Text: 'agello-next (7b872544) and the v0.18.0 source' become our build and the release.
corrected_text: In our build and the release Agello ships, with the executor's own sampler (SessionConfig::UseExternalSampler false, the default; the C++ runtime, the C API and the Swift wrapper never set it, and only Google's web package, which our tree removed, passes a caller's useExternalSampler through), LlmLiteRtCompiledModelExecutorBase::Decode keeps the last token of every decode step or MTP round as the pending input token, counted in current_step but not yet written to the KV cache; when that token is a stop token, Tasks' stop filter drops it from the text and the decode loop ends, so after a reply that ended on a stop token as the last token of its step or round, the stop token is the executor's pending token. In our build it also stays pending when an MTP round emitted tokens after it, which DecodeOneStep rolls back (ours: e62e6ff1).

note: Re-pin 2026-11-17: at b7b856a0 decode still makes the pending token an id-only TokenData (Decode 1611-1632), the lookups for the prefill's last token and GetTokenToDecode (876-929, 1060-1095) and FillInputBufferWithToken's id-and-zeros fallback (499-537) are unchanged, but our a82611eb (2026-11-17) adds LookupPendingTokenEmbeddings (539-563), called in PrefillInternal before writing a pending token to the embeddings and per-layer inputs (694-748), so the Gemma 4 files' prefill writes it from its embeddings. a82611eb is not an ancestor of the release Agello ships (6da75396), whose PrefillInternal (694-720), FillInputBufferWithToken (499-537) and Decode (1580-1601) still give the id-and-zeros row. Prefill signatures: generated/models/e4b-ours.md.
corrected_text: A pending token produced by decode is a TokenData holding only its id (the executor looks up embeddings only for a prefill's last token and, in GetTokenToDecode, for the token about to be decoded), and FillInputBufferWithToken writes a token without embedding as its int32 id in the first 4 bytes of the input and zeros after it. In our build, PrefillInternal first looks up the embeddings and per-layer embeddings of a pending token that has none (LookupPendingTokenEmbeddings; ours: a82611eb), so for the Gemma 4 E2B/E4B files, whose prefill signatures take embeddings and per-layer embeddings rather than token ids, the stop token that the next prefill writes first gets its own embedding. In the release Agello ships it gets the id-and-zeros row in both inputs instead, so its KV entry is not computed from '<turn|>'.

corrected_sources.detail: signature prefill_1024 inputs: embeddings FLOAT32[1, 1024, 2560], per_layer_embeddings FLOAT32[1, 1024, 42, 256], no token-id input

note: Re-pin 2026-11-17: RollBackProcessedTokens (executor.cc:565-595 at b7b856a0) unchanged: truncates to current_step-1 and re-adds that token as an id-only pending TokenData; SetCurrentStep (2069-2101) moves the step (plus MTP and ring state, LM-CNV-055); the channel filter's rewind and refill (conversation.cc:775-834). New at the pin: PrefillInternal looks up that pending token's embeddings (539-563, 694-748; a82611eb), so the re-pended '\\n' is written from its embedding and the refill matches the render. The release Agello ships lacks a82611eb, so there the position is still rewritten from an id-and-zeros row.
corrected_text:
In our build, after SetCurrentStep moves current_step below the processed-token count (as the channel-content filter's rewind does), the next prefill's RollBackProcessedTokens truncates the processed tokens and re-adds the token at current_step - 1 as a new id-only pending TokenData; after the filter's rewind to the checkpoint saved after the user prefill, that token is the '
' ending '<|turn>model
', which the refill prefill writes from its looked-up embeddings (ours: a82611eb), so the refill ('...<turn|>', with the final '
' left pending) matches the template's render. In the release Agello ships, that '
' position is rewritten from an id-and-zeros row.

note: Re-pin 2026-11-17: tasks.cc:362-377 at b7b856a0: when all_done inside a speculative round, DecodeOneStep moves current_step back by tokens_after_stop = sequence_length - 1 - step (our e62e6ff1, 2026-11-17, as upstream's bcd7532b), so the stop token stays the pending token; the next prefill's RollBackProcessedTokens (565-595) re-pends it and LookupPendingTokenEmbeddings gives it its embeddings (a82611eb). The release Agello ships (6da75396 tasks.cc:363-373) still moves back by sequence_length - step, dropping the stop token, and re-pends the token before it id-only. So the claim now holds only for the release.
corrected_text: When an MTP round emits the stop token before its last emitted token, our build's DecodeOneStep::Run moves the executor's current_step back by the number of tokens after the stop token, so the stop token stays the pending token, as after a single-token step (ours: e62e6ff1). In the release Agello ships it moves current_step back by sequence_length - step, which drops the tokens after the stop token and the stop token itself; the next prefill then re-pends the token before the stop token (as an id-only TokenData, rewriting its position from an id-and-zeros row), so neither '<turn|>' nor the '\n' after it is in the KV cache at that turn boundary.

note: Re-pin 2026-11-17: at b7b856a0 the Gemma 4 file template goes through FixGemma4ToolTemplate (conversation.cc:160-184; agello_gemma4_template.h:24-38, 9a84a518, 2026-11-17): a model message with tool calls ends '<tool_call|><|tool_response>', the tool response leaves out its first '<|tool_response>' and gets no generation prompt, and the answer after it no '<|turn>model\\n' header; agello_gemma4_template_test.cc:96-114 and 117-126 check exactly these renders. The render difference (conversation.cc:297-320) for the tool message is then 'response:...<tool_response|>', written after the pending stop token (PrefillInternal 694-748, with its embedding, a82611eb). A call that stopped on '<turn|>' (106) leaves that token where the render has '<|tool_response>'. The release Agello ships (6da75396) has none of 9a84a518 and a82611eb: there the old description holds (file template render '<tool_call|><turn|>\\n<|tool_response>', test line 112; id-and-zeros slot, 694-720).
corrected_text: In our build, the Gemma 4 E2B/E4B file template goes through FixGemma4ToolTemplate (ours: 9a84a518), so a model message that is only a tool call renders ending '<tool_call|><|tool_response>' and the tool response continues from it ('response:...<tool_response|>', no generation prompt); after such a reply without reasoning that stopped on '<|tool_response>' (50), that stop token is pending, so the KV cache holds the render, and the answer generated after the tool response follows '<tool_response|>' directly, as later renders have it (a call that stopped on '<turn|>' (106) leaves that token where the render has '<|tool_response>'). In the release Agello ships, the file template renders '<tool_call|><turn|>\n<|tool_response>' and later renders put '<|turn>model\n' before the answer, so the KV cache holds '<tool_call|>', the stop token's slot (an id-and-zeros row), then '<|tool_response>response:...<tool_response|>', and the answer without that header.

note: Re-pin 2026-11-17: GetTokenCount (conversation.cc:936-938), current_step (executor.h:126-128) and ProcessedTokens::TokenCount (base processed_tokens.cc:31-33) unchanged. Recounted against the render at the pin: a reply without reasoning ending '<turn|>' pending lacks the '\\n' (1 lower; MTP-inside now the same, X-GAP-005); a tool-call reply stopped on '<|tool_response>' renders '<tool_call|><|tool_response>' with that token counted pending (equal; X-GAP-006); the answer after a tool response has no '<|turn>model\\n' in later renders (no further difference); a reasoning refill equal (X-GAP-004). The release Agello ships keeps the old counts (1 lower for a tool-call reply too, 2 lower for MTP-inside, a further 3 lower for an answer after a tool response).
corrected_text: Conversation::GetTokenCount returns the executor's current_step, which counts the pending token (ProcessedTokens::TokenCount is the processed tokens plus one when a token is pending). Compared with the token count of the Gemma 4 file template's render of the same history (assuming the model's tokens equal the render's encoding of its text), in our build it is 1 lower for each reply without reasoning that ended with its stop token pending, except a tool-call reply that stopped on '<|tool_response>', which counts equal, and equal after a reasoning refill. In the release Agello ships it is 1 lower for a tool-call reply too, 2 lower instead when an MTP round emitted the stop token before its last token, and a further 3 lower for an answer generated right after a tool response without reasoning (the '<|turn>model\n' later renders put before it).
